what: d1-3B: time per decision on the Mac (Apple M4 Max, macOS 27.0 26A428), Swift Release CLI `d1 decide --warm --reps 20`, one process per form and item inside the machine-wide GPU lock window, two rounds; a process counts when no other GPU job ran during it and the one-minute load average stayed at or below 12. A decision = images + graph + readout (the tower calls and image rows, the state resets and graph calls, the readout and the response). round7 = every form of rounds 5-6 (two windows, 2026-10-08), round10b = the S = 64 control, S = 128 and the static forms (2026-10-09 02:01-02:21), round11_int8mlp = the int8mlp S = 64 bundle's AOT asset against its .aimodel specialized by the Swift process (JIT) (2026-10-09 07:04-07:08), round11_fp16 = the same for the fp16 S = 64 bundle as exported (07:15-07:20), round11_fp16_stripped = the same for the shipped fp16 bundle, its debug locations stripped (d1_3b_decode_fp16_pf64_s with the tower d1_3b_vision_fp16w32_s, 08:04-08:08) = the card's Mac table; *_jit_vs_aot_p = per timed question the JIT's p against the AOT asset's and the oracle.

removed: per-call ms lists (call_ms, first_call_of_process_ms; each transcript keeps its medians)
hidden-dump file names and hashes (npz, npz_key, npz_sha256, hidden_npz) and the hidden rows' lowest positions
the oracle's probabilities inside the transcripts (probs_oracle: they are in fixtures-d1-3b.json)
token ids and rendered prompt text (row_ids, ids, text, instructions, state, criteria)
other sessions' processes seen by the drivers (other_gpu_processes*, other_gpu_jobs*, busiest, top)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b/ (not in the repository)
trimmed.paths: local paths rewritten: the lane directory as $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b, the repository relative, the home directory as ~, the checkpoint snapshot as <snapshot>, the overlay venv as <overlay venv>, temporary directories as $TMPDIR, Xcode as $DEVELOPER_DIR, the phone's app container as <app container>, the phone's ids as <udid> / <coredevice id>

round7.what: round 7: per form x item the Swift Release CLI's decision ms (AOT; the JIT form apart) and the Python reference's (timing.py), on the Mac GPU inside this round's _GPU_LOCK window
round7.clean_rule: no other GPU job during the process and the one-minute load <= 12 at its start, end and every 2 s poll (Kev card §Time per decision); Python also timing.py's contended false
round7.swift_ms_definition: per decision: images + graph + readout of the trace's seconds (the row build and the picture's decoding not) = timing.py's latency_ms; median / p10 / p90 over the clean processes' 20 reps each

ship_draft.rule: the fastest PASS form on one_question; on another workload a form more than 3 % faster is an exception draft (the supervisor decides)
